Name: Jehiel the Gershonite
Summary: Gershonite by whose hand the precious stones given for the house of God were kept.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 29:8: Gershonite by whose hand the precious stones given for the house of God were kept.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jehiel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
